title: Pål Andrestuen
world: Old rural Norway, long ago. A small farm on a green hillside: the farmhouse is a dark log house with a grass roof, a stone doorstep and small-paned windows; across the yard stand Pål's smaller, crooked log cottage, the other house, and a big grey barn with a wide double door. Below them a meadow slopes down past a half-built fence of slanting grey poles to Pål's brown field, a little brook and a birch hill. The farmhouse kitchen has a long scrubbed table with benches, an open hearth with a black pot, and a plank door that opens inwards, with room to hide behind it. Rømmegrøt is thick, creamy-white sour-cream porridge in a big round wooden bowl, with a golden pool of melted butter in the middle and cinnamon sugar on top. Lefse is a big, round, thin, soft flatbread.
palette: Late spring at ploughing time: rich chocolate-brown ploughed earth, birches in bright lime-green new leaf, golden marsh marigolds along the brook, and warm, still sunshine under a clear sky. Indoors: warm hearth firelight and the creamy white of the porridge.

cast.name: Tjenestegutten
cast.description: En lur gårdsgutt som hører alt det mannen ikke hører, og som vedder ti daler med kona om hemmeligheten hennes.
cast.look: A very skinny, quick farm boy of about thirteen with a mousy-brown pudding-bowl haircut, a narrow, sunburnt face with a pointed chin, a wide, sly grin and quick green eyes that miss nothing. He wears a baggy, faded blue linen shirt and patched brown trousers held up by a single strap, too short for him so his bony ankles show, and he goes barefoot. His floppy grey-green knitted cap is always either on his head or waving in his hand.
cast.portrait: Background: the wide door of the big grey barn.

cast.name: Kona
cast.description: En kone som koker verdens beste rømmegrøt og serverer den i smug til Pål, som aldri glemmer å si det.
cast.look: A pretty, lively farm wife of about thirty-five, of medium height, with a round, dimpled face, a small pointed nose, bright dark-brown eyes under arched eyebrows and wheat-blonde hair in a thick braid coiled at the back of her head with a red ribbon. She wears a sky-blue laced bodice over a pale-yellow blouse with puffed sleeves, a long red-and-white striped skirt, a big white apron and a string of red glass beads around her neck.

cast.name: Den døve mannen
cast.description: En snill og arbeidsom mann som ikke får med seg alt som blir sagt, og som derfor ofte blir ledet inn i morsomme misforståelser.
cast.look: A huge, slow, kind-hearted farmer of about fifty-five, tall and broad as a barn door, with a long, calm face, a big round nose, sleepy pale-blue eyes under bushy eyebrows, and a big, fan-shaped, straw-coloured beard, with straw-coloured hair combed straight back. He wears a black-and-white speckled knitted jumper with silver clasps at the neck, brown knee breeches, white knitted stockings and heavy boots, and has big, work-worn hands.
cast.portrait: Background: the meadow with the half-built fence.

cast.name: Pål Andrestuen
cast.description: En ung nabo som gjerne stikker innom, men som blir lett skremt når han tror han har gjort noe galt.
cast.look: A soft, round-bellied young man of about twenty-five, shorter than most, with a round, pale, clean-shaven face, plump pink cheeks, a small upturned nose, big, droopy brown eyes and wavy light-brown hair combed into a proud swoop over his forehead. He wears a tight brown-and-cream checked jacket with big round wooden buttons straining over his tummy, a red-and-white spotted neckerchief, grey trousers and polished black shoes, and a wooden spoon always sticks out of his breast pocket.
cast.portrait: Background: the kitchen table with a bowl of porridge.

places.name: the Farm
places.look: A small farm on a green hillside: a dark log farmhouse with a grass roof, a stone doorstep and small-paned windows; across the yard, a smaller, crooked log cottage and a big grey barn with a wide double door. Below, a sloping meadow with a half-built fence of slanting grey poles, a winding footpath, a brown ploughed field with a simple wooden plough, a little brook with stepping stones, and a birch-covered hill beyond.

cover.prompt: A sunny morning on the Farm: Pål tiptoes across the yard towards the farmhouse on the tips of his polished shoes, licking his lips, his wooden spoon ready in his hand. In the open farmhouse door, the Wife beckons him in with one finger and a secret smile, a steaming bowl of porridge in her other hand. From behind the half-open barn door, the Servant Boy watches them both with one eyebrow raised.
cover.caption: Når mannen er ute og arbeider, smetter Pål inn til kona.
cover.alt: Pål lister seg over tunet med skjeen klar. I døra står kona og vinker ham inn med en dampende grøtbolle, og bak låvedøra står tjenestegutten og følger med.

illustrations.prompt: In the warm, firelit farmhouse kitchen, Pål sits at the long table with a big bowl of sour-cream porridge shining with butter, sugar and cinnamon, licking his wooden spoon with his eyes closed in bliss. The Wife stands beside him with her hands clasped, glowing with pride. Outside the small-paned window behind them, the Servant Boy peeks in over the sill with wide eyes, seeing everything.
illustrations.caption: «Den beste rømmegrøten i hele verden!» sier Pål. Men tjenestegutten ser alt.
illustrations.alt: Pål sitter ved bordet med en stor bolle rømmegrøt og slikker skjeen. Kona står stolt ved siden av, og gjennom vinduet kikker tjenestegutten inn.

illustrations.anchor: «Er det mat allerede?» sa mannen og lyste opp.
illustrations.prompt: In the wide doorway of the big grey barn on the Farm, with loose straw drifting in the air, the Servant Boy has spun round towards the yard, waving his cap high over his head and shouting towards the farmhouse. Beside him the Husband, leaning on a pitchfork full of straw, lights up with a big hopeful smile and pats his belly. Across the sunny yard, the farmhouse door stands just ajar.
illustrations.caption: «Ja da! Vi kommer!» roper gutten og vifter med lua.
illustrations.alt: I låvedøra snur tjenestegutten seg og vifter med lua mot stua. Mannen står med høygaffelen og lyser opp, for han tror det er mat.

illustrations.prompt: In the firelit farmhouse kitchen, the Husband and the Servant Boy sit at the long table, spooning sour-cream porridge from one big round bowl with a golden pool of butter in the middle. The Husband beams with delight; the Servant Boy glances sideways at the door with a sly look. The Wife stands by the hearth with her arms crossed and a sour face. Squeezed flat behind the half-open door, Pål sniffs the smell of porridge with his eyes closed, sighing longingly.
illustrations.caption: Bak døra står Pål og kjenner lukta. «Åååh», sukker han.
illustrations.alt: Mannen og tjenestegutten spiser rømmegrøt ved bordet, mens kona står sur ved grua. Bak døra står Pål klemt inntil veggen og snuser lengselsfullt.

illustrations.anchor: Pål Andrestuen sto ved plogen sin.
illustrations.prompt: Wide view down the sloping meadow of the Farm on a bright spring afternoon: the Servant Boy strolls down the winding footpath with a sly grin, tearing little bits off a big round lefse and dropping them behind him on the path, one here and one there. At the bottom, in the freshly ploughed brown field, Pål leans lazily on the handles of his wooden plough, yawning. Golden marsh marigolds shine along the brook.
illustrations.caption: Gutten smuler lefsa og slipper smulene på stien. En her, en der.
illustrations.alt: Tjenestegutten går nedover stien og slipper lefsebiter bak seg. Nede på åkeren står Pål og lener seg på plogen og gjesper.

illustrations.anchor: Da Pål fikk se mannen komme med øksa, la han på sprang.
illustrations.prompt: Pål runs for his life across the brown field towards the little brook, jacket flapping, arms flailing and his wooden spoon flying out of his pocket, pale with fright as he looks back over his shoulder. Far behind him, the Husband walks calmly down the footpath with the axe resting on his shoulder, looking puzzled, and the Servant Boy strolls after him with his hands in his pockets, grinning. The birch hill rises beyond the brook. Funny, not scary.
illustrations.caption: Hundre år med vedhogst hadde Pål ikke tid til!
illustrations.alt: Pål løper over åkeren, blek av skrekk. Langt bak ham kommer mannen rolig gående med øksa på skulderen, og tjenestegutten rusler etter og gliser.

illustrations.anchor: «Ikke vær sint på meg! Ikke vær sint på meg!
illustrations.prompt: On the footpath up the meadow towards the farmhouse, the Wife runs with her striped skirt gathered in one hand, looking back over her shoulder, waving her other arm and shouting at the top of her voice. A few steps behind her, the Husband comes running too, puffing and cheerful, his big beard blowing. Further back, the Servant Boy has stopped on the path, cups a hand behind his ear and grins from ear to ear. Two startled hens flap out of the way.
illustrations.caption: «Ikke vær sint på meg!» roper kona, så det høres over hele bygda.
illustrations.alt: Kona løper oppover stien mot gården og roper og vifter med armen. Bak henne springer mannen, og tjenestegutten står og lytter med hånden bak øret.

illustrations.anchor: Og Pål Andrestuen? Han lærte seg å koke grøt selv.
illustrations.prompt: Inside his own small, untidy log cottage, Pål stands at the hearth with an apron tied over his checked jacket, stirring a black pot of thick grey porridge with a long wooden spoon. He holds up a spoonful full of big lumps and stares at it with a disappointed pout. Spilled oats on the floor, a crooked stool and a thin wisp of steam. Warm, golden firelight.
illustrations.caption: Pål lærte seg å koke grøt selv. Den ble klumpete.
illustrations.alt: Pål står ved grua i den lille stua si og rører i en gryte. Han holder opp en skje full av klumpete grøt og ser skuffet ut.
